_note: How the bot treats files in each listing's Dropbox folder. First matching rule wins (case-insensitive regex on the path inside the listing folder). tier: public = anyone; ca = only after CA verified; sensitive = bot may read but any answer using it needs Pierce's Y; exclude = never loaded. Order matters (Nov 2 2026 audit): exclude rules run BEFORE the correspondence rule, so 'Insurance Correspondence' or a buyer's proof of funds in a correspondence folder is excluded, not loaded as sensitive.
_listing_status: A listing's status is the MOST restrictive of: HubSpot listing_status, HubSpot Sellers stage, and the Dropbox folder (02 - Under Contract = under contract). A 01 - Listed folder with no HubSpot match becomes an active listing on its own.
_data_room: data_room_block: a file matching that rule (archive, seller correspondence, contracts, financing, insurance, employment, tax returns, bank statements, LOI/BOV/listing agreement) must never sit in a listing's Dropbox data room. The doc sync checks every file in listing.facts.data_room_path; while any is there the bot stops using the data room link and texts Pierce once (src/dataroom.js, src/docs/sync.js).
